description: Nora must arrange care for her elderly cat Maple while she is away for four days, deciding where Maple will stay, who will provide care, the visit schedule, and how the daily medication will be given after checking in with two family members.

shared_context.S1: Nora will be away from Friday morning through Monday evening, and Maple needs someone responsible for her care during that period.
shared_context.S2: Maple is an elderly cat who needs care twice a day and takes one prescribed tablet each evening.
shared_context.S3: Nora is deciding whether Maple will stay at Nora's home or at someone else's home, who will care for her, and how the medication will be handled.
shared_context.S4: As part of Nora's usual pre-trip planning, she goes around the table and asks Alex and Priya for anything that should shape the care plan before she settles it.

PF1.text: Alex's dog is territorial and cannot safely share an apartment with Maple, so Maple must stay at Nora's home; Alex can visit Nora's home at exactly 07:30 and 19:30 each day.

PF2.text: Priya received a voicemail from Maple's veterinarian, Dr. Chen, saying the tablet must be given at 19:00 mixed into 2 tablespoons of wet food and must not be crushed; this instruction has not reached the group yet.

acceptance_conditions: Maple must remain at Nora's home.
Alex must be assigned as the primary caregiver.
The morning visit must be at exactly 07:30, and the evening visit must be adjusted to exactly 19:00 so the medication can be given on time.
The tablet must be given at exactly 19:00, mixed into exactly 2 tablespoons of wet food, and must not be crushed.
The settlement must include a commitment for Alex's twice-daily home visits, with the evening visit adjusted to 19:00.
The settlement must include a commitment confirming the exact medication instructions.
Priya's veterinarian instruction must be cited as justification after Priya reveals it.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') in ['twice_daily_home_visits', 'visit_schedule', 'visits'] and c.get('target') == 'Alex' for c in commitments) and decisions.get('visit_times') in [['07:30', '19:00'], ['7:30 AM', '7:00 PM'], ['07:30 AM', '07:00 PM'], ['7:30 AM', '19:00'], ['07:30', '7:00 PM']]
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') in ['medication_administration', 'medication_protocol', 'medication_plan_confirmed'] and c.get('target') == 'Alex' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Alex's territorial dog rules out moving Maple to Alex's apartment, assigns Alex to home visits instead, and supplies the 07:30 morning visit that remains in the adjusted schedule.

Dr. Chen's instruction changes the medication fields to 19:00, exactly 2 tablespoons of wet food, and not crushed, and requires changing Alex's evening visit from 19:30 to 19:00 with a matching medication commitment.
